tau_reference.reference: Planck 2018 VI, combined LCDM constraint, rounded abstract values

assumptions.calibration: Two explicit rankings: neutral_score uses three narrow-redshift constraints; combined_score adds ((tau-.054)/.007)^2. Descriptive scores, not joint likelihoods, confidence intervals, or independent validation. Wide-z bins are shown at centers only.
assumptions.stellar: Fixed mu=0, sigma=1.5 dex, epsilon_b=.03, paired100/100Myr source windows; mixed populations share fesc, pure PopII calibrated separately.
assumptions.tau: Density-weighted HII; normalized matter-density proxy traces baryons. X_H=.75 consistent with EoRCaLC. H+HeI together; HeIII tanh centered at z=3.5, width .5. Flat matter+Lambda background matching source ages.
assumptions.low_z: Spatial histories extended to last real density snapshot z=5.01; source rates independently calculated to z=5.00. Integrate actual Q_mass over all snapshots; require complete ionization at final snapshot, then use Q_mass=1 below it. No invented z=5.00 spatial field.
assumptions.high_z: Neutral before highest snapshot as initialized in spatial solver. No recombination-era residual electrons in reionization tau.
assumptions.limitations: Density cosmology remains unverified; overlapping excursion regions do not enforce global photon conservation. Bounds omit source sampling, density, helium and spatial solver systematics.
selection_rounds: Existing mixed f=.025,.05,.06,.07,.08,.1,.2 reused with full paired validation.
First new round: pure II f=.15,.175 to bracket existing .2; mixed .0675 explores the neutral-fraction/optical-depth tradeoff.

Second round: mixed .064 (joint score interpolation suggested .06388), .0725 (neutral-only interpolation .07253); pure II .1775 (three observed redshifts already covered in first round, interpolation .17719). Interpolated curves are proposal tools only.
assumptions.unrun_candidate: pure II .17 prepared and queued as159963, canceled while pending after interpolation gave .17719; no spatial output or score claimed for .17.
assumptions.selection: Extend the three displayed selections from the earlier 14-case calibration, holding fesc fixed; this is not a new parameter scan.
